newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Qilu Petrochemical sets maintenance plan.
newsitem.headline: China's Qilu Petrochemical sets maintenance plan.

text.p: China's Qilu Petrochemical Co plans a one-month shutdown starting on August 20 to overhaul major equipment, company officials said on Monday.
"It is a normal shutdown," a company official told Reuters.
"We inspect and repair our equipment at about the same time every year," the official said by telephone from Zibo city in eastern Shandong province.
The official added that all plants under the company would undergo maintenance related shutdowns, though he gave no further details.
